All selected literal formulas, quantities, numeric trivials, Shaman requirement and charge1/stack20 output profiles match rendered primary pages. Mist of the Wolf I uses the same bounded family as explicitly named II, without an item-ID introduction claim. Labelled PoR11 family reconstruction, independent maintained-primary manufacturing fields, no immutable2006/May2013 full-field claim or exact introduction dates. Modern Artisan Prize use association on Mist of the Ant is not an additional manufacturing gate. Philter of Aquatic Haunt selected Woundwart3/SageLeaf/Bugbane/PlainVial body only; separately listed old FroglokLeg/SeaSpirit TLP formula remains unqualified and is not added.
